releases.title: A clearer balance ring in the wallet Analytics tab

items.title: The ring no longer overlaps its figures
items.body: In the wallet Analytics tab the total now fits inside the ring, and every amount in the list shows your currency with two decimals instead of a long raw number.

items.title: Clients now see the balance ring too
items.body: The client wallet Analytics tab now shows the same ring as the photographer and event coordinator wallets, built from your balance, refunds, tips, gifts, donations and what is still processing.

releases.title: Analytics in the event coordinator wallet

items.title: A new Analytics tab in your wallet
items.body: The event coordinator wallet now has the same Analytics tab as the photographer wallet, with your available balance, what is still processing, and a chart of where your balance comes from.

items.title: Events and revenue by period
items.body: Pick Today, Week or Month to see how many events and photographers you worked with, a revenue trend, and the number of events in each interval, all compared with the previous period.

releases.title: Video wishes, a simpler event page after scanning, and no repeated sign-in details

items.title: Send a 1 minute video wish before an event
items.body: On an upcoming event you can now record a video wish of up to one minute for the organizer, just like on the website. Your text wishes also work again, they were being refused before.

items.title: A simpler page when you scan an event QR code
items.body: Scanning an event QR code now shows the essentials first: the event name, date, place, price and what you can do. A Show full details button opens everything else when you want it.

items.title: No more typing your name and email again
items.body: If you are signed in, wishes and live stream comments and video messages use your account name and email automatically. Guests only enter theirs once and the app remembers them.

releases.title: One frosted glass look for every pop-up

items.title: Pop-ups and sheets look like the sign-in screen
items.body: Every pop-up, bottom sheet and dialog now uses the same frosted glass design as the sign-in sheet: a blurred background, a soft see-through panel and clearer buttons, in both light and dark mode.

releases.title: A clearer update screen and a wallet reminder

items.title: See what changed before you update
items.body: When an update is ready, this screen now lists every new feature and fix, in plain words, before you tap Update now. If you missed earlier updates, you see those changes too.

items.title: Set up how you get paid
items.body: If you are a photographer or coordinator and have not added a withdrawal method yet, your wallet now tells you as soon as you open it, with the three steps to add one. Choose Do it later and it reminds you on your next visit.
